incidents.name: APIG token business-logic flaw
incidents.notes: APIG's transfer logic mis-accounts the liquidity pairs' balances so the attacker could shift value between the APIG pairs and swap the imbalance out for their BETH and USDT reserves.

sources.ref: onchain review: APIG 0xDc630Fb4F95FaAeE087E0CE45d5b9c4fc9888888 created 2023-08-26T15:44:50Z by 0x38bff01ba3d4fd8b9d36f3a7fc1b5f591cee8bb7, unrelated to attack sender 0x73d80500b30a6ca840bfab0234409d98cf588089; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the attacker received 72,127.08 USDT and 59.5 BSC-pegged ETH; 59.5 ETH x $1,625.97 at incidentTimestamp 1694174399 (DefiLlama coingecko:ethereum) = $96,745, giving $168,872 in total, matching the ~$169K reported.
